nom: Onekind Solardrops SPF 55 Daily Broad Spectrum Sunscreen

segments.oily: One reviewer with typically oily skin found it did not get oilier by end of day, but another worried the heavier texture would worsen oiliness in humid months and a different reviewer reported it left her skin looking greasy/oily all day.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it moisturizes without feeling dry, chalky, or greasy, blending well with their skin tone under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers with sensitive skin report zero irritation or reactions, calling it their first daily sunscreen that doesn't sting eyes or irritate skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing older/mature skin (60-year-old, 'older skin', nearing 40) report it melts in without settling into fine lines and adds moisture and glow rather than looking heavy.
segments.combination: One reviewer notes she still pairs it with a moisturizer in colder weather but doesn't feel an absolute need to layer more, suggesting balanced hydration.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with fine lines or mature skin say it melts in without settling into lines and works well as a primer/base over aging skin; no negative reports specific to aging skin were found.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report lasting hydration and a dewy, moisturized look without chalkiness; no dissent reported for this concern.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it takes red tints away from cheeks; another with rosy/fair skin says it evens tone without looking pasty.
concerns.barrier: Sensitive-skin reviewers report no reactions or irritation even with daily use, suggesting it is well tolerated, though one non-sensitive reviewer found the texture heavy and sticky enough to affect makeup application.
concerns.spots: No reviewers specifically describe active blemish/spot treatment results with this product.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts report none ('doesn't make me break out', 'no more breakouts'), but one reviewer worried a heavier feel could contribute to breakouts if hands aren't washed before reapplication.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say it does not add oiliness and controls shine through the day; however, a few others describe a heavy, greasy, or shiny finish, including one who felt it made her skin oilier-looking by day's end.

aspects.libelle: Heavy or greasy texture for some

extraits.texte: Heavy shine on skin, hard to rub in all the way, tint stays on skin like makeup. Used a few times and won't again.

I purchased Solar Drops and the nighttime Dream Cream only because I received a special discount via a daily newsletter. I was not in the market for SPF because I've used one I've liked for a few years. When I first put it on, I did think it would not be for me. It is heavier than I would have liked and worried it'd only make my oily skin more oily. I was completely wrong! Solar Drops acted as a great base/primer with SPF. My skin did not feel greasy after 10 hours. My make up looked freshly applied throughout the day. I've notice my skin looks much more even toned. The drawbacks are the price, and it might too heavy for my skin during the humid months. However, I'm leaning to toward a future purchase.

This Serum is a dream-like texture that melts into your skin. I have 60 year-old skin and it melted in without hanging out in any of my fine lines, so I have a soft, moist look and a perfect palette for my make up. I even tried it later in the day, for afternoon sun exposure, after I had make up on and it went on smoothly and added a fresh look of hydration-not oily or heavy, just the right amount of dewy smoothness. I love that this is SPF 55, so I'm getting the protection I want without heavy white/blue lotion. Thank you for creating such a lovely product!! I will be purchasing again!

I have extremely sensitive skin and daily sunblock has always been an issue for me because I react so badly to it. I've been wearing this daily for a week now and have had zero reactions. It doesn't feel greasy, absorbs into my skin nicely, and the faint fragrance is nice. I've not worn makeup over it yet (I don't wear makeup during allergy season) but I'm planning a trial run with a full face of makeup tomorrow. But, it gives my face a great glow solo so I don't feel like I'm not wearing makeup

I love OneKind but this product was not my favorite. There was no white cast and the tint worked well with my skin tone but the sunscreen felt very heavy and sticky on my skin and made my skin look greasy/oily for the rest of the day. I also felt like my makeup did not go on well after using Solardrops and also looked greasy.

I have very sensitive skin, but this does not irritate my skin. I love that it has a subtle tint to help even skin tone. When I put it on it gives me a dewy, even look. It also has a very pleasant smell. I use it as my daily sunscreen and love the extra benefits.

I have very dry skin and it's hard to find a facial sunscreen that doesn't feel dry or chalky on me. This one moisturizes without feeling greasy and because it's slightly tinted, it blends in perfectly with my skin tone. I wear it under makeup everyday.
